verses.text: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
lines: He makes peace in his high places.

verses.text: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
lines: On whom does his light not arise?

verses.text: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
lines: How then can man be just with God?
Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

verses.text: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
lines: Behold, even the moon has no brightness,
and the stars are not pure in his sight;

verses.text: How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”
lines: How much less man, who is a worm,
the son of man, who is a worm!”
